name: agent-workflows-runner
description: This repository is its own marketplace: it hosts the agent-workflows-runner plugin from the same tree it develops it in, so the placed copy and the tested copy are one thing.

plugins.name: agent-workflows-runner
plugins.description: The whole QA lifecycle as slash commands: qw-plan and qw-cases author test docs, qw-bind binds each case to the executable that runs it, and qw-review-bind audits the pair for divergence. Each producer is paired with a review gate; every project-specific value resolves from that project's .claude/rules/project-profile.md. Requires the agent-workflows plugin for the shared report and profile-doctrine rules.
